Brief

Read the official campaign brief first (Campaign Details in Resources). Every clip is reviewed against it.

Source: campaign-approved BILF Podcast episodes only, listed in the brief. Nothing else pays. Name the guest or episode in your caption so we can confirm source fast.

$2.00 per 1K views. 2,000 views to qualify, $200 cap per clip. 40%+ US/UK/CA/AU audience.

Engagement (updated Oct 20): 1.0%+ engagement rate AND at least 1 real comment per 1,000 views. Posts with zero comments or shares are not eligible.

Account (updated Oct 20): account must be 30+ days old with prior non-campaign posts. New or empty accounts are not eligible.

Verification: views and engagement are checked before payout. Purchased or automated views = rejected without payout and removed from all Runback campaigns.

Rejected on engagement and think it's wrong? Post a screenshot of the clip's native analytics (TikTok Studio > Viewers, IG Insights > Audience, YouTube Studio > Reach) in Whop support. Real distribution gets flipped the same day.

9:16, 15 to 60 seconds, burned-in subtitles, "BILF Podcast" on screen, show tagged + #bilfpodpartner in the caption.

No fan page required. Post first, then submit the link here. Join the Runback Discord (Resources) before you submit.

Content requirements

No reposted or recycled content

Creator requirements

Clippers who can find the moment and cut fast. You read the brief, pull the strongest 15 to 60 seconds from a full BILF Podcast episode, and post from a page you actually run. Clean subtitles, no filler, "BILF Podcast" on screen. No fan page needed. Approved clippers get first access to the next Runback.TV campaign.
